observations: Photos show stacks of used tires stored indoors/out of direct sun.
No clear tire sidewall text is readable (brand/model, size, DOT, or load/speed rating not legible).
Tread looks worn on many tires; some have visible scuffs/patches/uneven wear, but exact condition cannot be confirmed from these angles.
Some tires appear to be mixed sizes/types (at least visually), but the exact sizes are not readable.

claims.evidence: Seller text only; photos do not show readable brand/origin markings to confirm Belgium tires or distribution status.

risks.risk: Tire brand/model and exact size (e.g., 195/65R15, 225/45R17) are not readable, so the buyer may receive the wrong fitment.
risks.proof: A clear close-up photo of each tire sidewall showing size + brand/model (and ideally DOT/load/speed).
risks.if_unproven: Price as mixed/unknown used tires with worst-case fitment risk (treated as not guaranteed for the buyer’s vehicle).

risks.risk: Condition/remaining tread depth is not measurable from these photos; some tires may be near end-of-life or have damage.
risks.proof: A close-up of tread depth (or a ruler measurement) plus photos of any cracks, bulges, punctures, or sidewall damage.
risks.if_unproven: Price as worn used tires (not new, not guaranteed good tread).

risks.risk: Mixed tire types (possibly different sizes/axle types) could be included in the lot.
risks.proof: Photo showing the full lot with each tire’s size visible, or a list of quantities by size.
risks.if_unproven: Price as mixed used tires (no guarantee of uniform set).

risks.risk: Age/DOT year cannot be verified; older tires may be unsafe even if tread remains.
risks.proof: Clear DOT code close-up on multiple tires (at least 2–3).
risks.if_unproven: Price as older used tires (age not verified).

proof_requests: Send a clear close-up photo of the sidewall on each tire showing: brand/model, size, load/speed rating, and DOT date code.
Send tread-depth measurements (or a photo with a ruler) for at least 2–3 representative tires.
Confirm whether the lot is a uniform set (same size/type) and list quantities by size.
response.reason: The photos confirm used tires are present, but the key details needed to price correctly (exact size/brand/model and verified condition/DOT) are not readable. Without that, any price would be guesswork.
